title: Investor-Paid Credit Ratings and Managerial Information Disclosure
eligible_reason: The underlying design is a staggered binary treatment (post_ejr = firm-year covered by Egan-Jones Ratings; EJR initiates coverage of different firms in different years), but every reported main-text specification is estimated on a matched STACKED sample (sample_stacked.dta) with cohort-by-firm FE (cohort_firm_1perc) and cohort-by-year FE (cohort_year) - a stacked DiD, which PROTOCOL Section 2 excludes. Table III column 1 is the only column without controls, and it is stacked. The single non-stacked TWFE regression (Table A3 Panel H: absorb(gvkey_1_perc fyear)) is in the appendix and includes the additional treatment regressor post_sp (S&P coverage) plus 16 time-varying controls. Not classified as a near miss because the primary exclusion reason is the stacked design rather than controls.
design_notes: Treatment: EJR coverage initiation (event_year by firm; post_ejr = fyear >= initiation). Matched sample: each EJR-covered firm matched to control firms by propensity score (pscore <= 1% caliper; cohort_firm_full = 1:3; cohort_firm_closest = 1:1), stacked by cohort with event_window relative years. FE globals: $FEs = cohort_firm_1perc cohort_year. Controls: lev mb mcap roe vroe ret_ann ret_std loss rd rd_miss zscore special_item ln_analysts io_total debtfinancing equityfinancing. Figure II: stacked event study (bef3..aft2 dummies with controls and post_sp). Figure III: placebo randomization. Table VII: forecast-level triple interactions. Table A3: robustness incl. ppmlhdfe and 'traditional TWFE'. sample_compustat.dta (full Compustat, with post_ejr, fyear, numgvkey, ln_badnews_freq) would permit constructing an unstacked TWFE, but no such specification is reported in the main text.
estimators_reported: stacked matched DiD TWFE with cohort-firm and cohort-year FE (Tables III, IV, VI, VIII, A2, A3)
traditional TWFE with firm and year FE, controls and post_sp (Table A3 Panel H, appendix)
